alias-history.summary: Bind nested aliases at their original source position
alias-history.fix: Bind each alias to the preceding anchor target on its first source-order visit and reuse that binding during later expansion. Historical expansion must not re-register anchors into the live environment. Keep real cycles bounded and typed as AliasExpansionBudgetExceeded. Add both duplicate-anchor counterexamples across value, stream, and document extraction; preserve existing anchor and budget tests.

fatal-stream-errors.summary: Keep every fatal stream diagnostic in AST stream parsing
fatal-stream-errors.fix: Filter streamErrors with isFatalCode, matching the document and value-parser filters. Add the cross-document tag-handle regression and change the erroneous success assertion at YamlDocument.coverage.test.ts:17-19 to a typed failure. Coordinate with tag-handle-composition in g5: after its validation move, the fatal error may belong to a document rather than streamErrors, and both channels must remain fatal.

lint-fix-order.summary: Select conflicting edits by their actual intervals
lint-fix-order.fix: Check actual fix intervals rather than a monotone lastEnd frontier. Preserve diagnostic-order priority for overlapping and same-offset edits, then apply every accepted edit through YamlEdit.applyAll. Add a custom-rule regression with disjoint fixes in reversed edit-offset order, retaining overlap and zero-length priority tests.

diagnostic-position-index.summary: Index source positions once for diagnostic batches
diagnostic-position-index.fix: Add a reusable position index and indexed batch conversion in YamlDiagnostic.ts; build it once per source operation and reuse it in Yaml.ts, YamlDocument.ts, YamlVisitor.ts and YamlFormat.ts batch paths. Preserve standalone fromRaw, diagnostic order, LF/CR/CRLF/LS/PS, and offsets inside CRLF. Add an operation-count or scaling regression for many duplicate-key diagnostics and retain existing position assertions. Keep the implementation within these existing files.

regional-effect-equality.summary: Remove the native Object.is comparison without changing signed-zero behavior
regional-effect-equality.fix: Replace Object.is with Effect primitive equality plus an explicit numeric zero-sign comparison. Preserve NaN equality and the fallback when -0 renders as 0. Retain and extend regional-modification signed-zero regressions. Checker hardening is outside this module inventory; no Laws checker file is assigned.

invalid-header-quoted-hash.summary: Keep quoted hashes in invalid block-scalar headers
invalid-header-quoted-hash.fix: Track single- and double-quote state only in the invalid-header scan, including doubled single quotes and double-quote backslash escapes. Split comments only outside quotes; preserve the round-2 unquoted-header split. Test quoted hashes, a real comment after the closing quote, stripComments output, and exact token spans.

fold-tab-fidelity.summary: Do not fold a scalar before an interior tab
fold-tab-fidelity.fix: Exclude width-fold split points that move a tab to the start of a continuation line. Add the public block-folded stringify counterexample and extend the folding generator to interior tabs with positive lineWidth; compare decoded values with the independent yaml parser.

cst-block-entry-boundary.summary: Respect line breaks embedded in block-scalar CST spans
cst-block-entry-boundary.fix: Use source spans to detect same-line key promotion and subsequent entry boundaries, including breaks contained inside scalar or collection nodes. Preserve the preceding block scalar as a value and emit the following empty key. Add literal and folded regressions beside existing CST empty-key tests.

visitor-stream-reexecution.summary: Create a fresh visitor generator for each stream execution
visitor-stream-reexecution.fix: Return Stream.suspend(() => Stream.fromIterable(visitGen(text, options))). Add full-collection-twice and partial-then-full regressions on the same stream; preserve event ordering and lazy construction.

requote-schema-models.summary: Make the requote payload and named policy schema-derived
requote-schema-models.fix: Define an identity- and field-annotated structural RequoteScalarInput schema, reusing ScalarStyle, with unknown value, optional tag/anchor accepting their existing undefined compatibility, and finite offset/length fields. Derive the same-name type and retain plain structural inputs without per-call decoding. Define annotated LiteralKit(["conservative", "escaping"]) for RequoteMode and derive its type. Preserve conversion behavior and module initialization. Leave the anonymous inline quote-character domain anonymous; no named QuoteCharacter kit is required. Added-export and systemic law-deviation recording belongs to the central codemod.

parser-state-schema.summary: Derive mutable parser state from an annotated schema
parser-state-schema.fix: Define a file-local annotated structural ParserState schema using the existing token schema and derive its type. Keep pos and depth writable through field modifiers or the established derived mutable-field type. Preserve plain-object construction, parser behavior and depth guards; do not validate on each parser step.

flow-empty-key-span.summary: Locate explicit empty flow keys at the question indicator
flow-empty-key-span.fix: In the flow colon branch, replace a preceding node-less key with a zero-length null plain scalar at explicitKeyOffset when no metadata-generated key replaced it. Skip intervening comments as at comma boundaries. Preserve metadata-bearing keys and invalid tight ?: syntax. Add {? : 1}, nested duplicate empty-key offsets 9/16, and comment-separated regressions alongside the comma tests.

nested-flow-comment-lines.summary: Keep multiline nested flow renderings intact
nested-flow-comment-lines.fix: Promote a flow map or sequence to multiline layout whenever any rendered child spans lines. Preserve child line breaks; append commas and parent trailing comments after the final child line. Cover nested flow maps/sequences with comments through document stringify and independent-parser round trips.

flow-alias-key-spacing.summary: Separate alias keys from flow value indicators
flow-alias-key-spacing.fix: Apply the existing block-map key-separator logic in both flow-map rendering branches: emit *a : val for alias keys and preserve metadata-only empty-key separation. Test flow maps with and without comments using both the port and independent yaml parser.

alias-tag-properties.fix: Extend shared alias-property validation to reject pending tags with an existing fatal diagnostic such as UnexpectedToken at tagSpan. Preserve the anchor check and recovered alias AST. Add block-map and block-sequence tagged-alias regressions.

explicit-multiline-keys.summary: Exempt explicit quoted keys from the implicit multiline-key rejection
explicit-multiline-keys.fix: Check the existing explicit-key exemption before rejecting quoted scalar keys containing line breaks. Add explicit single- and double-quoted multiline acceptance regressions while retaining multiline implicit-key rejection.

empty-key-value-comments.summary: Preserve comments consumed between an empty key and its value
empty-key-value-comments.fix: Return the existing ConsumedValue payload from the empty-key value consumer and attach sameLineComments and leadingComments using the named-key path. Preserve cross-line next-key lookahead. Test separator-line and own-line comments on empty keys through parse/stringify.

empty-document-final-newline.summary: Honor finalNewline for canonically framed empty documents
empty-document-final-newline.fix: Apply finalNewline to assembled empty-document marker output. Remove only the terminal newline when false, retaining the separator between --- and .... Add canonical start-only and start/end-marker option regressions.

duplicate-node-properties.summary: Validate duplicate properties before overwriting or collapsing metadata
duplicate-node-properties.fix: Validate duplicate scalar tag/anchor slots before commitOuterIfNewlineSeen merges or clears them in block.ts. Apply equivalent pending-property validation before metadata replacement in document.ts and flow.ts. Preserve legal outer-container/inner-key splits and the recovered last-property AST while recording fatal diagnostics. Add multiline block, root, and flow multiple-tag/multiple-anchor counterexamples.

composer-cr-comments.summary: Use physical CR/LF/CRLF boundaries throughout comment attribution
composer-cr-comments.fix: Recognize LF, lone CR, and CRLF counted once in sameLineSpan, hasBlankLineBetween, blankLineAboveStart, hasBlankLineBelow and columnAt. Update both LF-only line-start scans in block.ts trimDisownedTrailingComments as well. Keep isOwnLineAt/isAfterIndicatorOnly behavior. Compare CR inputs with LF twins for key-line/own-line comments, blank lines, empty-key comments, escaped node spans and nested terminal-comment ownership.

document-end-cr-position.summary: Report EOF positions after a trailing lone CR
document-end-cr-position.fix: Recognize a trailing lone CR as a physical break in endOfStreamPosition, reporting the following line at character 0. Test one and multiple CR terminators in diagnostics and inference. Preserve current insertion bytes; this position fix must not change the endsWith-LF insertion policy.

flow-comment-before-value.summary: Accept comments between a flow colon and its value
flow-comment-before-value.fix: Distinguish an entry awaiting its value from completed entry content when arming separatorRequired. Clear completed-content state at the first structural colon or gate the comment arm appropriately. Add valid map and implicit sequence-map cases with comments before values; keep missing-comma and comment-before-colon regressions. Use correctly matched brackets in test inputs.

flow-property-empty-key-once.summary: Materialize property-bearing empty explicit flow keys once
flow-property-empty-key-once.fix: At comma and closing boundaries, create one explicit empty key using pending tag/anchor metadata and its resolved empty value. Register that anchor, consume the metadata once, and avoid a subsequent phantom node. Test parsed values, AST pair counts and {? &a, next: *a}, {? &a}, {? !!str}; preserve empty-key source positions.

tag-handle-composition.summary: Validate actual tag properties in every document
tag-handle-composition.fix: Perform named-handle validation during every document composition, filtering to consumed property offsets in state.tagOffsets. Remove only the corresponding handle check from the pre-composition cross-document pass to avoid duplicates; retain directive-placement checks. Test undeclared scalar/collection tags in document one and tag-shaped plain continuation text in later documents. Coordinate the AST parseAll assertions with g1.

document-end-empty-fidelity.summary: Do not erase an explicit empty document when removing its sole marker
document-end-empty-fidelity.fix: Keep the forbidden-end-marker diagnostic but withhold removal when the final document has no content and no explicit start marker independently preserving it. Inspect the final document rather than first-document context. Test standalone and comment-prefixed ... streams with independent document counts, including safe removal when a start marker remains.

plain-scalar-blank-lines.summary: Exclude composed scalar-content blank lines from layout fixes and inference
plain-scalar-blank-lines.fix: Collect composed sourceMultiline scalar spans through walkScalars once per rule operation. In both empty-lines checking and inference, skip blank lines whose offsets lie inside those spans, retaining existing token-span protection. Test multiline plain map values, flow/block sequence items, max 0/default settings and unchanged block scalars with independent value fidelity.

indent-document-reset.summary: Reset explicit-key continuation state at document markers
indent-document-reset.fix: Clear explicitKeyColumn before continuing on document-start or document-end tokens. Test an unfinished explicit key followed by ---/... and a deeper plain, quoted or block scalar in the next document; assert both expected indentation diagnostics and spaces votes while retaining same-document continuation exemptions.

eof-keep-chomp-fidelity.summary: Withhold EOF insertion that adds a keep-chomp scalar content break
eof-keep-chomp-fidelity.fix: Keep the eof-newline diagnostic but omit insertion when completing a final whitespace-only line inside a keep-chomp block scalar adds a retained content newline. Add literal |+ and folded >+ fidelity regressions using the independent yaml parser, since the current port parser masks this difference.

mapping-key-subtree-policy.summary: Exclude whole collection-valued key subtrees from value-only scalar rules
mapping-key-subtree-policy.fix: Add a walkScalars traversal mode excluding entire mapping-key subtrees while retaining immediate-parent roles for existing callers. Use it for quoted-string checking/inference and for truthy checking when checkKeys is false. Add sequence-key and mapping-key diagnostics, fix and strict-inference regressions; retain checkKeys true behavior.

hyphen-scan-scaling.summary: Precompute hyphen relocation safety instead of scanning every suffix
hyphen-scan-scaling.fix: Compute reusable relocation-safety data once per line or token stream and query it for each hyphen; eliminate repeated same-line suffix scans. Preserve compact collection and explicit-indent scalar protections, including hyphen-safe-map-fix. Add a bounded scaling or operation-count regression for recovered deep input rather than relying on parser depth to bound lint work.

indent-own-line-properties.summary: Look past own-line node properties when pairing a key with its sequence
indent-own-line-properties.fix: For indentSequences checking/inference pair scans, skip lines containing only anchors/tags and pair the sequence with the nearest earlier opening key. Keep those property lines in the indentation-unit stack and leave aliases as content. Test own-line anchor, tag and combined forms for explicit policy, consistent drift and strict inference.

hyphen-safe-map-fix.summary: Keep safe outer-hyphen fixes before explicit-indent mapping values
hyphen-safe-map-fix.fix: Withhold an explicit-indent scalar fix only when the nearest separated structural indicator before the header, skipping whitespace/tag/anchor properties, is a hyphen affected by the deletion. A preceding colon does not withhold. Apply the safe -   - item: |2/>2 fix while preserving protection for -   - |2/>2, chomp orders and node properties, and the existing safe -   |2 fix. Assert decoded-value fidelity.

indent-bom-and-spaces.summary: Measure YAML indentation in U+0020 and skip the stream BOM
indent-bom-and-spaces.fix: Count leading U+0020 spaces rather than trimStart whitespace. Exclude a single initial U+FEFF at offset 0 and carry that width into every probe offset, including token lookup and diagnostics. Retain tab-indented-line skipping. Add BOM diagnostics/consistent-inference tests and prevent NBSP or other non-YAML whitespace from counting as indentation.
